title: wedelia acapulcensis var. ayerscottiana
intro: Wedelia acapulcensis var. ayerscottiana, commonly known as Yellow Beggartick or Mexican Daisy, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help in reducing pain, swelling, and infection. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Beggartick include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its potential in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
